hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a bilinear interaction between x2 and x5: same-sign pairs push the target above the prediction and opposite-sign pairs push it below.
rationale: All five positive residuals (+0.16) have x2*x5 > 0 (about 1.77, 0.80, 0.24, 0.49, 1.46), and all five negative residuals (-0.16 to -0.17) have x2*x5 < 0 (about -0.32, -0.36, -0.63, -1.04, -0.53). Neither x2 nor x5 alone separates the groups, since both take either sign within each group, so the product is the relevant term.
